description: Capability for the shell and settings webviews (design.md §4.3). Scoped by webview label, not window label, so it never reaches the `svc-<id>` service webviews that share the `main` window. Grants the app commands declared in build.rs (`allow-<kebab-command>`), `core:event:default` for the shell's event listeners, and `core:window:allow-set-focus`; no `core:default`.
